project: MyGenie PMS — Guest Folio Detail Page
target_audience: Hotel front-desk staff (daily checkout/payment workflows) and hotel owners/managers (balance review)

typography.anti_default_rules: Do NOT use Inter or Roboto for main page titles; use Poppins 600/700 with tight tracking for headlines.

hierarchy.section_heading: text-lg font-semibold text-[#1A1A1A] flex items-center gap-2

owner_visual_combinations.overview: The owner requested visual options to evaluate before finalizing. Below are 3 distinct visual combinations comparing all 5 design decisions, followed by the explicitly recommended set.

option_sets.name: Option Set A: Flat Single-Scroll & Modal Workflow

decisions.decision_1_layout: Option A — Single vertical scroll with long linear stacked cards
decisions.decision_2_print_folio: Option A — Print Folio button hidden completely
decisions.decision_3_record_payment: Option A — Inline pop-up Modal over page center
decisions.decision_4_departed_guest: Option B — Identical layout with a prominent top green banner 'Checked Out ✓'
decisions.decision_5_balance_display: Option A — Single combined 'Balance Due' headline figure

option_sets.pros_and_cons: Simple linear layout, but causes heavy vertical scrolling on long stays with F&B items, and modal overlay hides background context during payment.

option_sets.name: Option Set B: Accordion Collapsible Sections

decisions.decision_1_layout: Option B — Collapsible accordion sections (Room Charges, F&B, Payments)
decisions.decision_2_print_folio: Option B — Disabled gray button with 'Print folio — coming soon' tooltip
decisions.decision_3_record_payment: Option B — Right side drawer slider
decisions.decision_4_departed_guest: Option A — Header badge 'Checked Out', actions hidden, subtle grayed surface wash
decisions.decision_5_balance_display: Option A — Single combined 'Balance Due' figure

option_sets.pros_and_cons: Reduces vertical height, but hides crucial financial details behind extra click/expand steps during high-speed front-desk checkouts.

option_sets.name: Option Set C: RECOMMENDED — Structured Dual-Column Grid with Side Drawer & Split Balance
option_sets.recommendation_rationale: Front-desk staff operate under extreme time pressure during guest checkouts. Set C keeps all room metadata and split balance always visible in a sticky top bar / summary card while providing a right-side drawer for Record Payment and Check Out (matching PmsCheckoutDrawer pattern). Staff never lose sight of room charges or F&B totals.

decisions.decision_1_layout: Option A (Structured Grid) — Clean 2-column card grid (Left: Guest & Room Info + F&B Orders; Right: Room Charges & Split Balance Summary + Primary Action Bar). All critical data is visible above the fold without accordion hiding.
decisions.decision_2_print_folio: Option B — Shown grayed/disabled button with 'Print folio — coming soon' tooltip (keeps staff aware that print functionality is coming in v2 without causing confusion).
decisions.decision_3_record_payment: Option B — Side drawer (PmsCheckoutDrawer / Partial Payment drawer pattern), maintaining full folio context behind the overlay.
decisions.decision_4_departed_guest: Option A — 'Checked Out' badge in top header, action buttons hidden, soft muted surface badge with settled confirmation indicator.
decisions.decision_5_balance_display: Option B — Split Balance Breakdown (Room Balance + F&B Balance = Total Balance Due), giving immediate clarity on outstanding F&B charges vs lodging.

key_functionalities: Guest Header Block: Guest name, phone, room number, room type/code, channel badge (WalkIn / Booking.com / Direct / Agoda), PAH/Prepaid badge, booking ID, check-in & check-out dates, actual checked-in time, pax count, special requests indicator.

Room Charges Block: Room Price, GST on lodging (room_info.gst_tax), Advance Paid, Total Amount Received (room_info.receive_balance), Balance Due (room_info.balance_payment — strict backend figure, NEVER calculated client-side).
Payment History Block: V1 displays cumulative advance and interim received totals with payment modes.
F&B Posted to Room Block: One row per associated food order (order #, amount, item summary) with tap-to-drill action opening OrderDetailSheet.
Action Buttons: [Check Out] (Action Green #329937), [Record Payment] (Brand Orange #F26B33), [Print Folio] (Disabled gray #9CA3AF with tooltip 'Print folio — coming soon').
Departed Guest View: Reached for departed/checked-out stays; action buttons hidden, 'Checked Out ✓' badge displayed prominently.

header_nav.back_button: ← Back to In-House Guests / Tape Chart
header_nav.title: Guest Folio detail for Room {roomNo}

page_layout_structure.left_column: lg:col-span-7 space-y-6 — Guest Metadata Card, Stay Details Card, F&B Orders Posted to Room Card (with OrderDetailSheet drill-down)
page_layout_structure.right_column: lg:col-span-5 space-y-6 — Financial Summary Card (Room Price, Lodging GST, Advance Paid, Received Balance, Split Balance: Room Balance + F&B Balance = Total Balance Due), Action Card ([Check Out], [Record Payment], [Print Folio])

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.arithmetic_rule: CRITICAL: NEVER compute or recompute financial balances on the frontend. Use exact backend figures: room_info.balance_payment, room_info.receive_balance, room_info.advance_payment, room_info.gst_tax.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.color_palette_strictness: Use brand orange (#F26B33) for key totals and secondary payment actions. Use action green (#329937) ONLY for primary Check Out button. DO NOT use forbidden slate gray or Tailwind default blue/green.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.interactive_states: All buttons must include hover, active, and focus rings with exact text contrast. Disabled buttons (e.g. Print Folio) must feature aria-disabled and tooltip wrappers.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.drawer_and_sheets: Integrate Record Payment via side drawer and F&B order rows via OrderDetailSheet drill-down.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.owner_decision_switch: Include an interactive visual toggle bar at the top of the page allowing the hotel owner to switch live between Option Set A, Option Set B, and Option Set C (RECOMMENDED) to visually preview all 5 design decisions directly on the page.
